name: zerogpu
description: Run AI inference with ZeroGPU's open-weight models and specialized small models.
long_description: Bring a ZeroGPU API key to run OpenAI-compatible inference on open-weight models and ZeroGPU's specialized small language models (ZLMs) for generation, classification and extraction. Saving, replacing and testing a key runs one minimal chat completion on the zlm-v1-iab-classify-edge ZLM, which is charged to your ZeroGPU balance (a fraction of a cent) or, on an account with no balance, uses one of your free trial calls. All forwarded inference is charged to your ZeroGPU account. The gateway keeps the key off your Sprite; the key's own project is used for every request. Supports chat completions and the Responses API, including SSE streaming. Model listing, embeddings, moderations, audio, batches, files, API-key management, billing and account routes are not forwarded.

messages.400: ZeroGPU rejected the request; check the model ID and request body
messages.402: ZeroGPU balance exhausted; add credits or enable autopay at platform.zerogpu.ai
messages.403: ZeroGPU rejected the API key; check it or create a new one at platform.zerogpu.ai
messages.404: ZeroGPU model not found; check the model ID at docs.zerogpu.ai/docs/model-catalog
messages.429: ZeroGPU rate limit reached; retry after the retry-after interval

presentation.tagline: Open-weight models and specialized small models without storing your ZeroGPU key on a Sprite.
presentation.setup: Log in at platform.zerogpu.ai/dashboard, open API Keys and create a key (it starts with `zgpu-api-`).

notices.title: Billing
notices.body: Inference is charged to your ZeroGPU account. Saving, replacing and testing a key runs one minimal chat completion on `zlm-v1-iab-classify-edge`, which costs a fraction of a cent or, with no balance, uses one free trial call. A key with no balance and no trial calls left fails the check with 402.

notices.title: Scope
notices.body: Only `POST /v1/chat/completions` and `POST /v1/responses` are forwarded, including SSE streaming. Requests run in the key's own project. Model listing, embeddings, moderations, audio, batches, files, API keys, billing and account routes are not forwarded.
